acceptance_criteria: docs/live/DESIGN.md section 7; one test per criterion in tests/live/test_live_cases.py
not_frozen_here: no campaign, no population, no real history binding (history.ATP/WTA are PENDING in the committed config), no rung other than elo
rehearsal: synthetic world only (tests/live/world.py); no real event, page, player, result or network request; the parser was additionally checked for structure (template names, match counts per round and status) against five retained archive draw pages without printing names or scores
revisions_before_freeze: fixture records name their state `fixture_status` (the field `status` is reserved for outcome-like vocabulary and refused on fixture input)
the version content hash excludes each row's receipt_id so an identical capture is recognised as no_change while keeping its own receipt
unused helpers deleted after the first full gate passed (no behaviour change; the 17 live cases, hygiene and CLI tests re-run green)
